info.title: comtradebulk
info.description: Premium APIs to get bulk files. A subscription key is required. See examples at https://bit.ly/42JNSaZ

get.description: Get the list of bulk files including their URLs for download.

parameters.name: typeCode
parameters.description: Type of trade: C for commodities and S for service

parameters.name: freqCode
parameters.description: Trade frequency: A for annual and M for monthly

parameters.name: clCode
parameters.description: Product classifications: HS, SITC, BEC (for goods) or EBOPS (for services).

parameters.name: reporterCode
parameters.description: Reporter code (Possible values are code of the countries separated by comma (,))

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: Year or month. Year should be 4 digit year. Month should be six digit integer with the values of the form YYYYMM. Ex: 201002 for 2010 February. Multi value input should be in the form of csv (Codes separated by comma (,))

parameters.name: publishedDateFrom
parameters.description: Publication date From YYYY-MM-DD

parameters.name: publishedDateTo
parameters.description: Publication date To YYYY-MM-DD

parameters.name: isOrig
parameters.description: Original Reported Classification (1 is Original 0 is converted from original)

401.description: Missing or invalid subscription key (API Management).

403.description: "Session Invalid" (no requester email), or APIM quota / access denial.

429.description: Rate limit exceeded (API Management). See the Retry-After header.

get.description: Download the bulk file by providing the fileHash obtained from /get

parameters.name: reporterCode
parameters.description: Reporter code

parameters.name: fileHash
parameters.description: File hash, from the rowKey of the catalogue (get / getClassic / getTariffline) response

200.description: The bulk file (gzip-compressed text). Content-Type is the stored blob's type; Content-Disposition carries the file name.

401.description: Missing or invalid subscription key (API Management).

403.description: No requester email, the file is not available to a trial subscription, the download failed, or APIM quota / access denial. No body from the backend.

404.description: No file with this reporterCode / fileHash. No body.

429.description: Rate limit exceeded (API Management). See the Retry-After header.
